title: How is Zeus connected to The Rock?
description: A painting from the Aeneid, Caesar's own coins, Rome's emperors and the line of popes connect the king of the Greek gods to The Rock.
hook: How is Zeus connected to The Rock?

image.file: File:British (English) School - Venus Petitioning Jupiter on behalf of Aeneas - 653231 - National Trust.jpg

links.line: In the Aeneid, Venus pleads with her father Jupiter, the Roman Zeus, to protect her son Aeneas.

image.file: File:Gaius Julius Caesar, denarius, 44 BC, RRC 480-3.jpg

links.line: Caesar's family claimed descent from Aeneas, so in 44 BC his coins paired his face with Venus.

links.line: From Sylvester, the line of popes runs unbroken, pope after pope, all the way to Pope Francis.
In 2024, Pope Francis invited over a hundred comedians to the Vatican, and shook hands with Jimmy Fallon.
And in 2024, Fallon welcomed The Rock onto The Tonight Show.

fun_fact: Caesar's family, the Julii, claimed descent from Venus through her son Aeneas, and Caesar built a temple to Venus the Ancestress.
research_note: The owner wanted the chain to start inside the myths, so it crosses into history through Venus, the goddess Julius Caesar claimed as his ancestor.
